# zchzbjklg — github_intelligence module dependencies

No additional runtime dependencies beyond the project's existing product deps
(jsonschema, fastapi, uvicorn) and dev deps (pytest, ruff, PyYAML, httpx).

The source provider uses httpx (already in [project.optional-dependencies].dev)
for GitHub raw content and refs API calls. No new paid services, tokens, or
external repositories are required. The GitHub token is read from
C2C_GITHUB_TOKEN via ProviderSettings (see full_learning/providers.py); it is
never logged, serialized into exceptions, or persisted to disk by this module.

## Test dependencies

Tests use only the existing dev deps (pytest, httpx). No pytest-asyncio is
required: async tests are wrapped with asyncio.run() in a fresh event loop,
keeping pyproject.toml untouched.
